 LeBron James passes Jason Kidd for third all-time in assists
 In Pacers vs. Sixers, James dished out his 12,092nd career assist, passing Kidd for third on the all-time assists leaderboard.
 From NBA.com News Services
 November 15, 2026 8:37 PM In Sunday’s matchup against the Pacers, LeBron James became 3rd all-time in assists.
 LeBron James continues his climb up the NBA all-time record books.
 James passed Jason Kidd (12,091) for 3rd on the all-time assists leaderboard in the 76ers’ matchup with the Pacers on Sunday. He finished the afternoon with 15 points and 11 assists in a 131-124 win to get to 12,092 assists in his career.
 LeBron James finds VJ Edgecombe for his 11th assist of the game, passing Jason Kidd on the NBA's all-time leaderboard.
 The league’s all-time leading scorer is averaging 15.1 points, 7.2 rebounds and 6.5 assists in his historic 24th NBA season. He also is the league’s all-time leader in games played.
 James now trails only John Stockton (15,806) and Chris Paul (12,552) on the assists leaderboard.
 NBA.com will have more on this developing story.
